name: threshold two blocks a lone source and preserves immunity
input: one source separated from healthy cells by immunity
test:
assert simulate_with_immunity([[1, 2, 0], [0, 2, 0]], infection_threshold=2) == (0, [[1, 2, 0], [0, 2, 0]])
assert simulate_with_immunity([[2]], infection_threshold=3) == (0, [[2]])

name: threshold two infects between two sources without mutating input
input: two sources around one healthy cell above an immune barrier
test:
original = [[1, 0, 1], [2, 2, 2]]
assert simulate_with_immunity(original, infection_threshold=2) == (1, [[1, 1, 1], [2, 2, 2]])
assert original == [[1, 0, 1], [2, 2, 2]]
